1: AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH THE DATE AND TIME OF THE FIRST YEARLY ORGANIZATIONAL MEETING OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA; TO ESTABLISH THE DATE AND TIME OF THE REGULAR MONTHLY MEETING; AND TO PROVIDE FOR THE REPEAL OF CONFLICTING ORDINANCES; AND FOR OTHER
2:
WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia, is authorized by Article II, Chapter 4, Section 2-403 to establish the date and time of its regular meetings; and |

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Town Council deem it in the best interest of the citizens of the Town to establish the date and time of its regular meetings;

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Town Council of Clermont,

Georgia, and it is hereby ordained by the authority of same, as follows:
3:
The Mayor and Town Council shall hold the year’s first organizational meeting in the

Town Hall at seven (7) o’clock p.m. on the first Tuesday in January of each year.
4: The regular meetings of the Mayor and Town Council shall be held at seven (7) o’clock p.m. on the first Tuesday in each month.
5: This ordinance is created by the Mayor and Town Council pursuant to the authority granted under Article II, Chapter 4, Section 2-403, of the Town Charter.
6: Should any section or provision of this ordinance be declared by the courts to be unconstitutional or invalid, such decision shall not affect the validity of the ordinance, as a whole or any part thereof, other than the parts so declared to be unconstitutional or invalid.
7: Where there is an apparent conflict in this ordinance between specific and general provisions, it is the intention hereof that the specific provision shall control.
8: All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
9:
The effective date of this ordinance shall be upon approval of the Mayor and Town

Council of the Town of Clermont, Georgia.
